description_en: Performs instance-level verification for a check item
description_zh: 检查项下实例维度验证
kebab_example: aliyun sas verify-check-instance-result --check-id 16 --instance-ids i-2ze3a5ws0mjvqwqr0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --task-source YAO_CHI --check-ids 11 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: VerifyCheckInstanceResult

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the check item.

You can call the [ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~) operation to obtain the check item ID
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的ID。

您可调用[ListCheckResult](~~ListCheckResult~~)接口获取检查项ID
parameters.name: check_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of instance IDs of the affected assets for the check item.
Note: This parameter is actually required. If this parameter is not specified, the API returns a 400 error (Code: -101)
parameters.help_zh:
检查项影响资产的实例ID列表。
注意：本参数实际为必填项，未提供时 API 返回 400 错误（Code: -101）
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token is generated by the client and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性的客户端令牌。由客户端生成，长度不能超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The task source. Valid values:

YAO_CHI: ApsaraDB console
parameters.help_zh:
任务来源。取值：

YAO_CHI：瑶池控制台
parameters.name: task_source

parameters.help_en: The list of check item IDs
parameters.name: check_ids

FailInstances.description_en: The list of instances that failed the check

items.description_en: The instance that failed the check

OperateCode.description_en:
The operation code of the cloud service configuration check task. Valid values:

Throttling: Rate limited.
ActionTrialUnauthorized: Unauthorized error
OperateCode.description_zh:
云产品配置检测任务操作码。取值：

Throttling：频率限制
ActionTrialUnauthorized：未授权错误

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the request ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
